segments.oily: One reviewer with generally oily-leaning skin found it a bit too oily and felt a single drop was too much, though it eased dryness; another separately reports reduced oiliness overall.
segments.dry: A reviewer prone to dryness after glycolic acid saw no dramatic change and needed to alternate days, while several others without naming dryness as a chronic issue report it eased dry patches and boosted hydration.
segments.combination: One self-identified combination-skin reviewer says it absorbs well, causes no irritation, and 'looks good' on her skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers largely report no irritation, no burning or itching, and a soothing feel even with redness, though one noted her skin was 'a little sensitive to it at first' before adapting.
segments.normal: No reviewer explicitly identifies as having normal skin.
segments.mature: One reviewer, a self-described 40-year-old newb to skincare, reports brighter, smoother skin with twice-daily use and no adverse reactions.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mention it helps with fine lines and firmness, with one noting pores appeared minimized and skin felt 'firmed up' where applied; effects described as gradual rather than dramatic.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report improved hydration, plumpness, and softness with regular use; one exception found it did not feel very moisturizing and another felt it added little hydration or moisture at all.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers with redness-prone or sensitive skin describe soothing, comfortable wear and reduced redness with use, including one who chills it in the fridge specifically for redness relief.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer explicitly frames results in terms of barrier repair or damage.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fading dark spots and improved evenness of skin tone within weeks; no dissent noted.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some clearing of blemishes and dark marks, but one acne-prone reviewer noted slightly more blemishes since starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports noticeably less oiliness overall, and another with oiliness noted no oily feel or breakouts, though a different reviewer found the texture itself too oily/greasy for her skin.

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I don't love or hate this product. I have very acne prone skin and while this product hasn't caused me to have terrible breakouts, I have noticed a bit more blemishes since adding it to the routine. extraits.titre: A Lightweight Serum That Delivers Radiance
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I recieved this product from Clarins in exchange for my honest review. I've been using the Clarins Multi-Active Serum for several weeks, and it has quickly become one of my favorite morning skincare products. The texture is lightweight, silky, and absorbs beautifully without leaving any sticky residue behind. It layers well under moisturizer and makeup, making it easy to incorporate into my daily routine. My skin tends to be sensitive with occasional redness, and this serum feels soothing and comfortable every time I apply it. After consistent use, my complexion looks more hydrated, refreshed, and noticeably smoother. I especially love how it helps my skin appear more radiant and well-rested, even on days when I'm running on very little sleep. The packaging feels luxurious, and a little product goes a long way. While it won't provide overnight miracles, it delivers steady improvements in hydration, softness, and overall skin vitality.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this product. It combines AHA and Vitamin C in a serum that absorbs quickly and looks great. I have adult acne and sensitive skin. This cleared breakouts and dark spots and my skin glows. I will definitely be getting more.

Make sure you use sunscreen because AHA and BHA will make you sun sensitive! Otherwise - my skin feels nice and smooth and absolutely is brighter. No weird feelings after I put this on (IE burning, itchy, etc) which is always a positive. No adverse reactions and there is no smell to this - also a plus!

This multi active brightening serum from Clarins rules! It has been so beneficial to my skin. I have noticed brightening, smoothing, and much less oiliness on my face overall. My skin feels supple and hydrated, and the product absorbs very well! I received my product in exchange for my review but all of my thoughts are my own. I like to keep it in my refrigerator for maximum benefit to my skin. I highly recommend it to anyone and will definitely be buying this in the future!
